paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
notes: Paper sets new 90% CL exclusion limits from SuperCDMS Soudan (CDMSlite + iZIP Ge detectors) on both dark photon kinetic mixing (epsilon) and ALP axioelectric coupling (g_ae) over 40 eV to 500 keV, assuming the candidate is all of the galactic DM with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. The full limit curves are shown only in figures (Figs. 12-13, corrected in erratum); no numerical table is provided. Only explicit textual value extracted: epsilon < ~1e-15 near m ~ 100 eV (best sensitivity region; world-leading/competitive in 40-186 eV). The paper equally constrains AxionElectron: g_ae < ~1e-12 at a few hundred eV (strongest laboratory constraint for 40-186 eV); DarkPhoton chosen per pre-analysis hint and the abstract's emphasis. A separate extraction should be done for the g_ae limit.
